senses.gloss: f. (b. h.) raah, name of an unclean bird.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 63b:7">Ḥull. 63ᵇ</cite> <he>דאה ור׳ וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="D00012"><he>דָּאָה</he> II</cite>.
Ib. ר׳ זו איה … ר׳ שרואה ביותר raah is the same as ayah, and it is called raah, because its sight is exceedingly acute (ref. to Job XXVIII, 7).
